text:
Rowan: Quick thread on the webinar benchmark one-pager — need a punchy hero, 3 minimal charts, and two CTAs. Target: slide deck + short blog follow-up.

Priya: Proposed hero: "Latency you can promise. Cost you can control." Subtitle: "Three charts to show how config choices move the needle."

Leo: Charts we should include: 1) compact latency violin (median/p95/p99) by model+deployment, 2) stacked waterfall for $/1k tokens showing model, infra, and optimization savings, 3) small table showing recommended configs for Startup/Scale/Enterprise with expected p95 and $/1k.

Dani: Data ask: please include sample prompt mix (short/med/long), cache hit vs no-cache, batching profiles (none, moderate, aggressive). CSV headers: model, deploy_mode, quant, seq_bucket, median_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, cost_per_1k_usd, cache_hit_rate, batch_profile.

Rowan: Timeline: Priya hero + 2 alt lines by EOD today. Leo provide CSV by tomorrow noon. Dani mockups tomorrow afternoon. I'll stitch and send to ops by Friday.

BenchBot: Quick schema check passed for preview. Note: mean cache_hit_rate missing for some rows — please fill or set to 0.

Priya: Alt heroes: 
- Option A: "Serve predictable latency. Save per token."
- Option B: "Make latency a product promise, not a guess."
I prefer B for enterprise slides, A for landing copy.

Leo: Small reproducibility snippet for notes (pseudo):
```
# estimate per-1k token cost
sec = 0.85
gpu_rate = 2.8  # $/gpu-hour
cost = (sec/3600) * gpu_rate
print(cost)
```

Dani: For the waterfall, we'll highlight two knobs: batching and quant. Add a micro-annotation: "Cache hits reduce token costs by 30-60% depending on workload."

Rowan: Perfect. Also add a 2-line CTA: "Run your prompts — see your numbers" and "Talk to sales for Dedicated sizing". Keep social copy punchy.

Priya: Drafts uploaded to drive/marketing/bench-onepager/ — comments welcome.

Rowan: Closing loop. Check-in tomorrow AM if anything blocks. :rocket:
